definitions.explanation: Describes something that is acceptable or adequate, though not outstanding. Indicates a moderate, middle-ground level of quality or quantity.
When used with に, indicates doing something quickly and moving on, without lingering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧そこそこ⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ。
examples.english: The salary is so-so, but the work is easy.

examples.japanese: そこそこ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧だ。
そこそこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そこそこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I hurriedly finished breakfast and left.

examples.english: I cut the greetings short and headed to my next appointment.

examples.english: I left after rushing through my preparations, so I forgot something.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (so-so, moderate):
As an adverb, そこそこ goes straight in front of the adjective or verb it grades:
・そこそこ⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧ (fairly tasty)
・そこそこ⟦{売|う}れている→売れる：02012_ureru⟧ (selling reasonably well)

As a modifier it takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun; そこそこな is also heard but is the weaker option:
・そこそこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ (a reasonable price)
・そこそこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ (passable grades)

After a number, そこそこ means "just about that much, and no more": 30⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧そこそこ (barely thirty).

Sense 2 (hurriedly):
〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そこそこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb. The ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is obligatory here, and this is what separates sense 2 from sense 1:
・⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そこそこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}る→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧ (to leave after a hasty greeting)
The thing marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ is what got short-changed, so the sentence usually carries a hint of rudeness or regret.

NUANCE:
そこそこ says something is acceptable but not impressive — good enough to pass muster without standing out. Used of your own situation it sounds modest; used of someone else's work it can sound faintly dismissive, so it is safer in the first person.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦まあまあ→まあまあ：05430_maamaa⟧ - so-so, not bad; the everyday spoken equivalent
・⟦ほどほど→ほどほど：05312_hodohodo⟧ - in moderation; about restraint rather than about quality
・⟦それなり→それなり：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - reasonably, in its own way; grants merit judged against expectations
